input.label: SUPPORTED

supporting_evidence.quote: Information about our operating margin on a consolidated basis and by operating segment and Corporate is as follows: Year Ended December 31, 2025 2024 Consolidated 28.7 % 21.2 %

input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Coca-Cola's operating margin for fiscal year 2025 exceeded 25%. Evidence E2 explicitly provides the consolidated operating margin for the year ended December 31, 2025 as 28.7%, which is greater than 25%. This directly supports the claim. The evidence also defines operating margin as "a ratio calculated by dividing operating income by net operating revenues" and confirms this is for the consolidated basis. Since 28.7% > 25%, the claim is supported.
